repulsive.zh: 令人反感的、令人厭惡的
ai: The smell of the rotten food was absolutely repulsive.
腐壞食物的味道實在令人作嘔。
I found his arrogant attitude repulsive.
我覺得他那種傲慢的態度令人反感。
The sudden noise startled the baby.
突然的聲響嚇到了嬰兒。
She enjoyed the tranquility of the countryside.
她享受鄉間的寧靜。
The lake was a place of perfect tranquility.
那座湖是個絕對寧靜的地方。
Critics raved about the new film.
評論家對這部新電影讚不絕口。
Everyone is raving about the new restaurant downtown.
大家都在熱烈稱讚市中心那家新餐廳。
The patient was raving and could not recognize anyone.
病人胡言亂語，認不得任何人。
She has a deep fondness for her grandmother's cooking.
她特別喜愛外婆做的菜。
Children watched the magician with fascination.
孩子們看魔術師表演看得入迷。
He has a lifelong fascination with space.
他一輩子都對太空著迷。

hideous.zh: 醜惡的、令人不忍卒睹的
ai: The monster in the movie was hideous.
電影裡的怪物醜得嚇人。
They were shocked by the hideous crime.
那起駭人的罪行令他們震驚。
She came up with an ingenious solution to the problem.
她想出了一個解決問題的巧妙辦法。
A judge must remain impartial during the trial.
法官在審判期間必須保持公正。
We need an impartial witness to tell us what happened.
我們需要一位公正的證人來說明發生了什麼事。
He is an impulsive person who often buys things he doesn't need.
他是個衝動的人，常常買下不需要的東西。
It was an impulsive decision, and I regret it now.
那是個衝動的決定，我現在很後悔。
My eyes are red and irritated from the smoke.
我的眼睛被煙燻得又紅又痛。
The irritated skin needs a few days to heal.
發炎的皮膚需要幾天才會痊癒。
Her talent eclipsed that of all the other singers.
她的才華使所有其他歌手黯然失色。
The moon eclipsed the sun for a few minutes.
月亮遮住了太陽幾分鐘。
He likes to brag about how much money he makes.
他喜歡吹噓自己賺了多少錢。
We can't afford to be complacent about safety.
我們不能對安全問題自滿。
After winning twice, the team became complacent.
連贏兩次之後，球隊變得自滿。
He was in a combative mood and ready for an argument.
他心情好鬥，準備跟人吵一架。
The two leaders had a combative exchange on live television.
兩位領導人在電視直播中進行了針鋒相對的交鋒。
His conceit made it hard for him to accept advice.
他的自負讓他很難接受別人的建議。
I detest cold weather and long winters.
我討厭寒冷的天氣和漫長的冬天。
Don't despair; things will get better soon.
別絕望，情況很快就會好轉的。
She despaired of ever finding her lost dog.
她對找回走失的狗已不抱任何希望。
He is a devoted husband and a loving father.
他是個摯愛妻子又疼愛孩子的好丈夫。
She remained devoted to her family until the end.
她到最後都始終忠於她的家人。
The smell of fresh bread enticed us into the bakery.
剛出爐麵包的香味把我們引進了麵包店。
The store enticed customers with big discounts.
那家店用大幅折扣來吸引顧客。
She is held in high esteem by her colleagues.
她深受同事敬重。
Praise from teachers can raise a child's self-esteem.
老師的稱讚可以提升孩子的自尊心。

whim.zh: 突然的念頭、一時的興致
ai: On a whim, we decided to drive to the beach.
我們一時興起，決定開車去海邊。
He bought the car on a whim.
他一時興起就買下了那輛車。
The doctor treated every patient with humanity and respect.
那位醫生以人道和尊重的態度對待每位病人。
The soldier showed great humanity toward the prisoners.
那名士兵對俘虜展現了極大的人道精神。
I know the melody, but I forgot the lyrics.
我記得旋律，但忘了歌詞。
He wrote lyric poems about the sea.
他寫了一些關於大海的抒情詩。
She has a beautiful lyric voice.
她有一副優美的抒情嗓音。

instrumental.zh: 有幫助的、起重要作用的
ai: She was instrumental in getting the project approved.
她對這項計畫能獲得批准起了重要作用。
His advice was instrumental to our success.
他的建議對我們的成功很有幫助。
The album has both vocal and instrumental songs.
這張專輯同時有人聲演唱和純樂器演奏的歌曲。
The wicked king punished anyone who disagreed with him.
那個邪惡的國王懲罰任何不同意他的人。
A college degree is a prerequisite for this job.
大學學歷是這份工作的必要條件。
They have been intimate friends since childhood.
他們從小就是親密的朋友。
The restaurant has a warm and intimate atmosphere.
那家餐廳的氣氛溫馨又親切。
Bamboo is hollow inside.
竹子的內部是中空的。
His promises sounded hollow to everyone.
他的承諾聽起來空洞，大家都不相信。

marvel.zh: 令人驚奇的事物或人物
ai: The new bridge is a marvel of modern engineering.
這座新橋是現代工程的奇蹟。
Visitors marvel at the beauty of the old temple.
遊客對古老廟宇的美讚嘆不已。
We marveled at how fast the child learned to read.
我們對那孩子學會閱讀的速度之快感到驚奇。
She looked chic in her simple black dress.
她穿著簡單的黑色洋裝，看起來時髦又別緻。
They opened a chic little café near the station.
他們在車站附近開了一家別緻的小咖啡館。

delightful.zh: 令人愉快的、令人高興的
ai: The children were delightful company at dinner.
孩子們在晚餐時是令人愉快的陪伴。
She shook with fury when she read the letter.
她讀完那封信後氣得渾身發抖。
His fury was obvious to everyone in the room.
他的暴怒讓房間裡的每個人都看得出來。
He was haunted by memories of the war.
戰爭的回憶一直困擾著他。
She had a haunted look in her eyes.
她的眼神裡帶著揮不去的陰影。
Some students mocked him for his accent.
有些學生嘲笑他的口音。
Students took a mock exam before the real test.
學生們在正式考試前先參加了模擬考。
There was a queer smell coming from the basement.
地下室傳來一股怪味。
The teacher gave the noisy class a stern look.
老師對吵鬧的班級投以嚴厲的眼神。
To be blunt, your essay needs a lot of work.
說得直接一點，你的作文需要大幅修改。
He is known for his blunt way of speaking.
他以說話直來直往而聞名。
Cut the bread with a sharp knife, not a blunt one.
切麵包要用鋒利的刀，不要用鈍的。
The company's accounting methods are questionable.
那家公司的會計做法有疑問。
He has a peculiar way of walking.
他走路的樣子很奇特。
Her obsession with cleanliness affects her daily life.
她對清潔的執著影響了她的日常生活。
Fame has become an obsession for him.
名氣已成為他念念不忘的執念。
He felt righteous anger at the unfair treatment.
他對這種不公平的對待感到正義的憤怒。
She was a righteous woman who always helped the poor.
她是個正直的女人，總是幫助窮人。

eclectic.zh: 不拘一格的、兼收並蓄的
ai: She has an eclectic taste in music, from jazz to folk.
她的音樂品味兼容並蓄，從爵士到民謠都聽。
The shop sells an eclectic mix of old and new furniture.
這家店賣的新舊家具風格混搭、不拘一格。
The war brought misery to millions of people.
戰爭給數百萬人帶來痛苦。
She looked at his new house with envy.
她以羨慕的眼神看著他的新房子。
He looked desperately for a way out.
他拼命尋找出路。
The lost hikers waved desperately for help.
迷路的登山客絕望地揮手求救。

vain.zh: 徒然的、白費的（常用 in vain）

ai: He is so vain that he checks his hair in every window.
他愛慕虛榮到每扇窗戶都要照一下頭髮。
She was too vain to admit she needed glasses.
她太愛面子，不肯承認自己需要戴眼鏡。
The soldiers were held captive for two months.
那些士兵被囚禁了兩個月。
The vicious dog attacked the postman.
那隻凶惡的狗攻擊了郵差。
He spread vicious rumors about his rival.
他散布關於對手的惡毒謠言。
The government offered a bounty for catching the thief.
政府懸賞緝捕那名小偷。
She is tolerant of other people's opinions.
她能包容別人的意見。
Keep the soil moist but not wet.
讓土壤保持濕潤但不要積水。
The cake was soft and moist.
這個蛋糕又軟又濕潤。
The nurse was kind and sympathetic to the patients.
護理師對病人很親切又有同情心。
I'm sympathetic to your situation, but I can't help.
我同情你的處境，但我幫不上忙。
The street was covered in filth after the festival.
慶典結束後，街上滿是髒污。

outrageous.zh: 令人吃驚的、無法無天的、可恥的
ai: The price of the hotel room was outrageous.
那間旅館的房價貴得離譜。
It is outrageous that he was never punished.
他從未受到懲罰，這實在令人憤慨。
He looked at the cheater with contempt.
他以輕蔑的眼神看著那個作弊的人。
Being called lazy was an insult to him.
被說懶惰對他來說是一種侮辱。
The puppy looked so pathetic in the rain.
那隻小狗在雨中看起來好可憐。
That was a pathetic excuse, and nobody believed it.
那是個可悲的藉口，沒有人相信。
After months of stress, he began to fear for his sanity.
經過數個月的壓力，他開始擔心自己的精神狀態。
Take a break to keep your sanity.
休息一下，才能保持你的理智。
Please disregard my last email; it was sent by mistake.
請忽略我上一封郵件，那是誤寄的。

glowing.zh: 灼熱的、鮮豔的；熱烈讚美的
ai: The glowing embers kept us warm all night.
發紅發熱的餘燼讓我們整夜保持溫暖。
The film received glowing reviews from critics.
這部電影獲得了評論家的熱烈好評。

restless.zh: 焦躁不安的、不得安寧的

creep.zh: 躡手躡腳地走、緩慢爬行
ai: The cat crept slowly toward the bird.
那隻貓慢慢地悄悄靠近那隻鳥。
Ivy had crept up the walls of the old house.
常春藤爬滿了老房子的牆面。
She received an award for her exemplary service.
她因表現堪稱模範的服務而獲獎。
Cars release harmful pollutants into the air.
汽車把有害的汙染物排放到空氣中。
The factory was fined for dumping pollutants into the river.
那家工廠因為把汙染物排入河中而被罰款。
Women's intuition is said to be strong, but it is often just careful observation.
人們常說女性的直覺很強，但那往往只是細心觀察的結果。

ironic.zh: 具有諷刺意味的、諷刺的
ai: It's ironic that the fire station burned down.
消防局竟然被燒毀，真是諷刺。
The picture on the wall is crooked.
牆上的那幅畫掛歪了。
The mayor was a crooked politician who took bribes.
那位市長是個收受賄賂的不正派政客。
They were caught in a crooked business deal.
他們被抓到涉及一樁不正當的生意。
The old bridge cannot withstand heavy trucks.
這座老橋承受不住重型卡車。
We had a marvelous time at the festival.
我們在慶典上玩得非常開心。

vigorous.zh: 精力充沛的、強而有力的
ai: He is a vigorous old man who still runs every morning.
他是個精力充沛的老人，每天早上還跑步。
The committee launched a vigorous campaign against pollution.
委員會展開了強而有力的反汙染運動。
Drunk drivers are a menace to everyone on the road.
酒駕者是對路上所有人的威脅。
The new law aims to protect citizens from the menace of crime.
新法律旨在保護市民免受犯罪的威脅。
